{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the columns to understand the data
print('Columns:', df.columns.tolist())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values per column:\n', df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nNumber of duplicate rows:', df.duplicated().sum())

# Check unique values in key columns
print('\nUnique values in `arm`: ', df['arm'].unique())
print('\nUnique values in `severity`: ', df['severity'].unique())
print('\nUnique values in `response`: ', df['response'].unique())"}
